Container.Name: NuvioM3U
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Nuvio/Stremio addon that serves curated M3U live-stream lists. Each list gets its own manifest URL containing a random slug, so the URL cannot be guessed. Supports bulk M3U import, Xtream Codes accounts, multi-URL failover and stream health checks.
Container.Description: Turn any collection of M3U live-stream URLs into named lists you can install in Nuvio or Stremio. Create a list, fill it with streams under names you choose, then install that list's manifest URL.

Config.Name: WebUI / Addon Port
Config.Description: Port for the admin UI and the addon manifests.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database. Back this up.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS address this is reachable on, e.g. https://m3u.example.com (no trailing slash). Set this when using Pangolin or any reverse proxy, otherwise the manifest URLs will point at the container's internal address.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Leave blank for no password (only safe if a reverse proxy such as Pangolin authenticates in front). Set a password to protect the admin UI itself. Addon manifest URLs are never password protected - Stremio cannot sign in - which is why they carry a random slug.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Trust X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-Host. Leave true behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: HEALTHCHECK_INTERVAL_MINUTES
Config.Description: Probe every stream URL on this interval. 0 disables automatic checks; you can always check on demand from the UI.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns files in /config.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns files in /config.
